headline: Source: Packers lose DT Javon Hargrave for season to torn Achilles
summary: Tests confirmed Monday that Packers defensive tackle Javon Hargrave suffered a season-ending torn Achilles in Sunday's victory over the Bears, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: 49ers LB Dre Greenlaw Receives One-Game Suspension
summary: After a sideline dustup led to an ejection on Sunday, 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw will sit out Week 6. The NFL has suspended Greenlaw one game without pay for headbutting helmetless Seahawks linebacker Ernest Jones IV. Greenlaw may appeal the punishment. More to come…

headline: Lions’ Tom Kennedy Likely To Undergo Season-Ending Knee Surgery; Devin White Suffers Broken Forearm
summary: The Lions improved to 3-2 with a 45-21 thrashing of the Cardinals on Sunday, but they did not escape Arizona unscathed. headline: QB Tyler Huntley leads Ravens to comeback OT win vs. Falcons
summary: With Lamar Jackson still out, Tyler Huntley backed up the Ravens' faith in him by leading them to a 30-23 overtime win against the Falcons, during which Huntley was 11-for-11 passing for 80 yards on the final two drives.
